items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: He had a name like Reboski, or something like that, see?

ctx.x: So anyhow, he had a brother Sam Lyons, Sam Lyons got in an argument with the busboy. And they started fighting. Well, the busboy was Greek and Sam was Russian. So when they started fighting, they forgot their English altogether. One started talking in Greek and the other one started talking in Russian. And I still wouldn't have known, but one of the waiters, one of the white waiters, we had white waiters, see. He said, 'This is a funny argument. Here's one cursing one out in Greek and the other one in Russian.' I…
